title: Nonzero tensor product of finite modules over a local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring with residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$. If $M$ and $N$ are nonzero finitely generated $R$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then $M\otimes_RN\ne0$.
